children: Corporate earnings featured a notable lineup of reports from 6 key S&P 500 reporting firms across the information technology, health care, industrials, and consumer staples sectors.
Performance was strong, with 5 out of 6 reporting companies beating consensus EPS estimates and 1 falling short. Overall, 5 of the 6 firms delivered Y/Y profit expansion.
Revenue growth was equally robust, with 5 companies exceeding Wall Street expectations and 1 falling short. All 6 companies achieved Y/Y top-line expansion.
Let’s take a look at some of the companies that reported earnings this week:
